entries.en: to draw a sword from its sheath; to unsheathe a sword

entries.zh: 赎回当物；把典当之物赎回来
entries.en: to redeem a pledge; to take a pawned item out of pawn
entries.notes: L 栏即 desempeñar la prenda，H「當頭」明指当物，然首字「扔」与「贖/抽」义不合、R 栏 lig tong ren 疑与上行错位，故降为 medium。

entries.en: to redeem a pawn; to reclaim a pledged item
entries.notes: R 栏 tao tong teu 与「討當頭」密合，M 作 chiu 更近「抽（当）」，汉字与音写小有出入，据 L 栏定夺。

entries.zh: 解开包裹；拆开捆扎之物（从包袱中取出）
entries.en: to unbundle, to unwrap; to take something out of a bundle
entries.notes: H 栏只存音写 fung gi tay 而非汉字、M/R 皆空，仅据 L 栏 desembolar 的词义定夺。

entries.zh: 开心；心情舒畅、高兴起来
entries.en: to cheer up, to become glad; to be merry
to cease being angry; to calm one's anger

entries.zh: 息气；平息怒气、气恼消退
entries.en: to let one's anger cool; to calm down (of temper)

entries.notes: L 栏 Deserozar 非标准西语拼写、H/R 两栏俱空，M 仅存 tan oy 无从还原，故不作定解。

entries.zh: 使醒悟；破除迷误、去掉错觉
entries.en: to undeceive, to disillusion; to open someone's eyes
entries.notes: H 栏为音写 li ta 而非汉字、M/R 皆空，仅据 L 栏 desengañar 的词义定夺。
H/M/R 三栏俱空，仅存西语词头 Desfallecer（衰弱、昏厥、灰心），无从与汉字互证。

entries.zh: 命贱；不惜命、自轻性命（亡命豁出去）
entries.en: desperate, reckless of one's life; to hold one's life cheap

entries.zh: 心切贪命；心情急迫、贪恋活命
entries.en: anxious and clinging to life; impatient, in desperate eagerness
entries.notes: H 栏两处 [疑]，第二字疑为「急」而讹作 心/必，L 栏 uinir 当读 vivir（¿le pesa de vivir?），据 M/R 音读推补。

entries.zh: 扒裂；撕裂、扯裂（如掰折树枝般撕开）
entries.en: to tear apart, to rend (as a branch is torn off)
to tear open, to rip apart
to tear open; to pull apart, to force open

entries.notes: H 栏磨损且有 [疑]，M 作 ho、chay hio、chay hon（禍、災禍、災患）与 R 栏 hon（患）互证，故仍定为灾祸义。

entries.en: calamities, adversity; hardships and ill fortune
entries.notes: H 栏 [疑:捉/接/提] 与 L 栏不合，M 多处污损（T99）、R 仅存 cu 一音，仅据 eg（厄）、chian、hiong（凶）等残音推为困厄义。
